_comment: Canonical post-TTA Catalog C real-space dipole summary. Anchors the abstract headline 0.43-sigma null. The earlier outputs/dipole/summary.json is the PRE-TTA Catalog A pipeline run (2.31 sigma) and must NOT be quoted as the headline.

headline_status: This file is the canonical reproducibility anchor for the abstract real-space dipole null.
